title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
short_description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year transferred in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to landholding farmer families.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
verification_source: Official Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (pmkisan.gov.in)
nodal_agency: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DA&FW)
detailed_benefits: Direct financial benefit of ₹6,000 per annum per eligible farmer family, payable in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each. Funds are transferred directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
eligibility_summary: All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names. Excludes institutional landholders, farmer families holding constitutional posts, serving or retired government employees, professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs), and persons who paid income tax in last assessment year.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
Land Ownership Record / Record of Rights (RoR) / Khasra-Khatauni
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked with NPCI mapper)
Active Mobile Number
application_mode: Online via pmkisan.gov.in Farmers Corner or CSC / Village Nodal Officer
application_steps: Visit official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) and navigate to 'Farmers Corner'
Click 'New Farmer Registration' and choose Rural or Urban Farmer
Enter Aadhaar number and mobile number, select State, and verify via OTP
Enter land record details (Khasra/Khata number, survey number, area in hectares)
Upload land document and submit; application is verified by District Nodal Officer

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
short_description: Cashless health insurance cover of ₹5 Lakh per eligible family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empaneled hospitals.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
beneficiary_type: Deprived Rural Households, Identified Urban Occupational Categories & All Citizens Aged 70+
verification_source: National Health Authority (NHA) Scheme Guidelines & Ayushman Bharat Senior Citizen (70+) Expansion (pmjay.gov.in)
detailed_benefits: Provides health protection cover of ₹5 Lakh per eligible family per annum for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across more than 29,000 public and private empaneled hospitals nationwide. Covers pre-existing conditions from day one, 3 days pre-hospitalization, and 15 days post-hospitalization expenses including diagnostic tests and medicines. Under the 2024 Ayushman Vay Vandana expansion, all senior citizens aged 70 and above receive distinct ₹5 Lakh cover irrespective of family income.
eligibility_summary: Households identified through deprivation criteria (D1 to D7) in Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011 (SECC 2011) in rural areas, and 11 occupational categories in urban areas. All Indian citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for Ayushman Vay Vandana card irrespective of socioeconomic status.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Vulnerable families identified under SECC 2011 and senior citizens aged 70+

required_documents: Aadhaar Card
Ration Card / Family ID / NFSA Card
Active Mobile Number
application_mode: Online via beneficiary.nha.gov.in, Ayushman App, or walk-in at any Empaneled Health Care Provider (EHCP) / CSC
application_steps: Visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in or download the Ayushman App
Login using mobile number and Aadhaar OTP as Beneficiary
Search family record using State, Scheme (PM-JAY), Ration Card Number, or Family ID
Complete instant e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP, IRIS, or facial authentication
Download verified Ayushman Card immediately for cashless hospital admission

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 Lakh in hilly/difficult areas for constructing a pucca house with basic amenities.
beneficiary_type: Rural Houseless Households and Families in Kutcha/Dilapidated Houses
verification_source: Ministry of Rural Development Framework for Implementation & Cabinet Extension to 2028-29 (pmayg.nic.in; PIB PRID: 2043924)
nodal_agency: Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development
detailed_benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 per unit in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/North-Eastern/IAP districts. Additionally provides ₹12,000 for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin (SBM-G) and 90 to 95 person-days of unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGS (approx. ₹20,000 to ₹25,000). Total effective benefit exceeds ₹1.50 Lakh.
eligibility_summary: Rural households living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha wall and kutcha roof as identified by SECC 2011 and verified Awaas+ lists. Family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Excludes households with motorized vehicles, mechanized agricultural equipment, government employees, or paying income/professional tax.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all adult family members
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked)
MGNREGS Job Card Number
Consent letter for Aadhaar usage and geo-tagged photos of existing kutcha house
application_mode: Through Gram Panchayat / Village Assembly or Block Development Office (Awaas+ portal)
application_steps: Gram Sabha identifies eligible beneficiaries from verified SECC/Awaas+ lists
Block officials conduct geo-tagged inspection of existing living conditions
Selected beneficiary registers bank account and Aadhaar on AwaasSoft portal
Sanction order is issued and 1st installment (approx 25%) transferred to bank account
Subsequent installments released based on geo-tagged construction stage verification

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
short_description: Government housing initiative providing financial assistance and interest subsidies to construct, purchase, or rent pucca houses for 1 crore urban poor and middle-class families.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
beneficiary_type: Urban EWS, LIG, and Middle Income Group (MIG) families
verification_source: Union Cabinet Decision & MoHUA PMAY-U 2.0 Operational Guidelines (PIB PRID: 2043924; pmay-urban.gov.in)
nodal_agency: Mission Directorate, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & State/UT Housing Departments
detailed_benefits:
Under the Cabinet-approved PMAY-U 2.0 framework (covering 1 crore urban families over FY 2024-25 to 2028-29 with ₹2.30 lakh crore government assistance and total investment of ₹10 lakh crore), assistance is provided across 4 distinct programme components:
1. Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC): Financial assistance up to ₹2.50 Lakh per eligible EWS family to construct a new pucca house on their own land.
2. Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP): Financial assistance up to ₹2.50 Lakh per EWS house constructed by States/UTs/ULBs and private developers, with additional Innovation Housing Technology assistance for modern building systems.
3. Affordable Rental Housing (ARH): Rental accommodations for urban migrants, working women, industrial workers, and street vendors via vacant government housing (Model 1) or newly constructed ARHCs (Model 2).
4. Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS): 4% interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹25 Lakh for houses valued up to ₹35 Lakh for EWS, LIG, and MIG families (loan tenure up to 12 years), with a maximum subsidy of up to ₹1.80 Lakh credited via 5-yearly installments through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility_summary: Families living in statutory urban areas belonging to Economically Weaker Section (EWS, annual income up to ₹3 Lakh), Low Income Group (LIG, annual income ₹3 Lakh to ₹6 Lakh), and Middle Income Group (MIG, annual income ₹6 Lakh to ₹9 Lakh). Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. For BLC, land ownership is required. EWS eligibility applies to BLC, AHP, and ARH; ISS covers EWS, LIG, and MIG categories.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Urban EWS, LIG, and MIG families

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
PAN Card (for loan and subsidy processing)
Proof of Address and Urban Domicile (Ration Card / Voter ID / Utility Bill)
Income Certificate / Salary Slip / Form 16 / Self-declaration of Income
Affidavit affirming no pucca house is owned anywhere in India
Land Title Deed / Patta / Possession Document (for Beneficiary-Led Construction)
Home Loan Sanction Letter from Lending Institution (for Interest Subsidy Scheme)
application_mode: Online via pmay-urban.gov.in / Unified Web Portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs) and Urban Local Bodies
application_steps: Visit the official PMAY-U 2.0 unified portal (pmay-urban.gov.in) or your local Urban Local Body / CSC
Select the applicable programme component: BLC (own land), AHP (partnership housing), ARH (rental), or ISS (home loan interest subsidy)
Authenticate identity using Aadhaar and complete biometric / OTP verification
Enter family income, demographic details, bank account information, and upload required documents
Submit application and obtain Application Tracking Number for verification by Urban Local Body / SLNA

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
short_description: Guaranteed lifelong pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month from age 60 for unorganized sector workers based on monthly contributions.
verification_source: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) APY Operational Guidelines & Tax-payer Exclusion Notification (pfrda.org.in)
nodal_agency: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
detailed_benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60 until death. After subscriber's death, identical pension is paid to spouse for life. On spouse's death, full accumulated pension corpus (up to ₹8.5 Lakh for ₹5,000 pension) is refunded to designated nominee.
eligibility_summary: Any Indian citizen between 18 and 40 years of age having a savings bank account or post office savings account. Under statutory amendment effective 1st October 2022, any citizen who is or has been an income-tax payer is not eligible to join APY.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
Savings Bank Account Passbook with Auto-Debit facility
Active Mobile Number
application_mode: Online via netbanking / mobile banking or in-person at any Bank branch or Post Office
application_steps: Visit the bank branch or post office where you hold a savings bank account, or log in to netbanking
Fill the APY Subscriber Registration Form specifying chosen monthly pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000)
Provide Aadhaar number, mobile number, and spouse/nominee details
Authorize auto-debit of monthly contribution from your savings bank account
Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) acknowledgment via SMS

title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
short_description: Institutional collateral-free business loan facility up to ₹20 Lakhs for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises across Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, and Tarun Plus categories.
beneficiary_type: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprise owners and entrepreneurs
verification_source: Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance Notification & MUDRA Guidelines (financialservices.gov.in / mudra.org.in)
nodal_agency: Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance & MUDRA Ltd (subsidiary of SIDBI)
detailed_benefits:
Institutional collateral-free micro-credit / business loan facility provided through Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Small Finance Banks, and MFIs. The scheme offers repayable loans (NOT a cash handout, grant, or unconditional subsidy; approval is subject to lending bank appraisal and viability) under four tiers:
1. Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for early-stage micro-units.
2. Kishore: Loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5,00,000 for established small businesses.
3. Tarun: Loans above ₹5,00,000 and up to ₹10,00,000 for expanding business enterprises.
4. Tarun Plus: Loans above ₹10,00,000 and up to ₹20 Lakh (₹20,00,000) (effective October 2024 pursuant to Union Budget 2024-25 enhancement), specifically reserved for entrepreneurs who have previously availed and successfully repaid a loan under the Tarun category.
Credit guarantee protection is provided to lending institutions through the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU). No collateral is required, but loans carry commercial interest rates and must be repaid over standard bank repayment tenures (typically 3 to 5 years).
eligibility_summary: Any Indian citizen aged 18+ who is running or proposing a revenue-generating non-farm business in manufacturing, processing, trading, services, or allied agriculture. The applicant must have a viable business proposal, must not be an institutional loan defaulter, and must have a satisfactory credit history. For the Tarun Plus tier (> ₹10 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh), the applicant must have previously availed and successfully repaid a Tarun-tier loan without default. Note: Mudra provides repayable credit; loans are sanctioned at the discretion of the lending bank based on credit assessment and are never guaranteed or free subsidies.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Non-farm micro enterprise owners and aspiring entrepreneurs

required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN Card / Passport)
Proof of Residence (Aadhaar Card / Utility Bill / Domicile Certificate)
Proof of Business Identity and Registration / Udyam Registration Certificate
Bank Account Statement for past 6 months
Business Proposal / Project Report with cost of machinery or working capital estimate
Repayment track record and clearance proof of previous Tarun loan (mandatory for Tarun Plus loans above ₹10 Lakh)
Passport-size Photographs
application_mode: Online via Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or offline at Member Lending Institutions (Commercial Banks, RRBs, SFBs, MFIs)
application_steps: Formulate a viable business plan and prepare projected income and expenditure or machinery quotations
Gather KYC proofs, Udyam registration certificate, and 6 months bank statements
For Tarun Plus (₹10L-₹20L), obtain proof of timely repayment of previous Tarun category loan
Apply online through Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any branch of a scheduled commercial bank, RRB, or Small Finance Bank
Bank reviews credit score, evaluates business viability, and sanctions repayable credit facility without collateral requirements

title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
short_description: Comprehensive support for traditional artisans and craftspeople: recognition, skill training with stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakh.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
beneficiary_type: Traditional Artisans and Craftspeople in 18 Specified Trades
verification_source: Ministry of MSME PM Vishwakarma Operational Scheme Guidelines (pmvishwakarma.gov.in; Cabinet Approval Aug 2023)
nodal_agency: Ministry of MSME in partnership with Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) & DFS
detailed_benefits: Official PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card. 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend. ₹15,000 digital e-voucher grant for modern toolkit purchase. Collateral-free enterprise development credit at concessional 5% interest rate (with 8% interest subvention paid by MoMSME): 1st tranche up to ₹1,00,000 (18 months tenure) and 2nd tranche up to ₹2,00,000 (30 months tenure). ₹1 per digital transaction incentive (up to 100 transactions monthly) and brand promotion assistance.
eligibility_summary: Artisans working with hands and tools in one of 18 traditional family trades (Carpenter, Blacksmith, Goldsmith, Potter, Sculptor, Cobbler, Mason, Weaver, Basket Maker, Doll/Toy Maker, Barber, Garland Maker, Washerman, Tailor, Fishing Net Maker, Boat Builder, Armourer, Locksmith). Minimum age 18 years. One beneficiary per family. Government employees and their family members are excluded.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades

required_documents: Aadhaar Card (biometric verification mandatory)
Active Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar
Bank Account Passbook / Details
Ration Card / Family details (for one-member-per-family verification)
Skill declaration in one of the 18 specified trades
application_mode: Online via Common Service Centres (CSCs) with biometric authentication
application_steps: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar, bank passbook, and mobile
CSC operator performs biometric authentication of applicant
Select trade from the 18 eligible crafts and fill family & bank details
Three-stage verification: Stage 1 by Gram Panchayat / ULB; Stage 2 by District Implementation Committee; Stage 3 by Screening Committee
Download PM Vishwakarma Certificate and receive training schedule SMS

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
short_description: Affordable collateral-free working capital micro-loans up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and cashback for urban street vendors.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
beneficiary_type: Urban Street Vendors, Hawkers, and Cart-pullers
verification_source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs PM SVANidhi Operational Guidelines & Extension (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in)
nodal_agency: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) & Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
detailed_benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan: 1st tranche up to ₹10,000 (1 year tenure); 2nd tranche up to ₹20,000 on timely repayment of 1st tranche; 3rd tranche up to ₹50,000 on timely repayment of 2nd tranche. 7% interest subsidy per annum credited directly to bank account on quarterly basis for timely repayment. Monthly cashback incentive up to ₹100 (up to ₹1,200 annually) for conducting digital transactions (₹1 per transaction). Zero penalty for early repayment.
eligibility_summary: All street vendors vending in urban areas possessing Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs). Vendors left out of ULB surveys can be recommended through a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) issued by ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC).

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Urban street vendors vending in peri-urban and urban areas

required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/TVC
Aadhaar Card (identity proof and Aadhaar-linked mobile number)
Bank Account Passbook / Details (Aadhaar linked)
Passport-size Photograph
application_mode: Online via pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, PM SVANidhi Mobile App, or via Common Service Centres (CSCs) and Banking Correspondents (BCs)
application_steps: Check vending status on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in using Aadhaar or CoV number
If name is not in survey, obtain Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Urban Local Body
Apply online or through CSC operator by uploading Aadhaar and bank details
Select preferred Lending Institution (Public/Private Bank, RRB, SHG Bank)
Bank sanctions and disburses loan directly to vendor's Aadhaar-linked savings account

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
short_description: Centrally sponsored financial scholarship providing 100% compulsory course fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowances for eligible SC, ST, and OBC students in higher secondary and higher education.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
beneficiary_type: SC, ST, and OBC students pursuing post-matriculation or tertiary education
verification_source: National Scholarship Portal Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment & Ministry of Tribal Affairs (scholarships.gov.in)
nodal_agency: National Scholarship Division, MoSJE & MoTA in coordination with State Welfare Departments
detailed_benefits: Provides Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scholarship support covering: 1. Full non-refundable compulsory fees (tuition fees, examination fees, library fees) charged by recognized educational institutions. 2. Monthly maintenance / academic allowance depending on course tier and residential status (day scholar vs. hosteller). Financial assistance is credited directly into the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
eligibility_summary: Indian national students belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Other Backward Classes (OBC). Must be enrolled in a post-matric or higher education course (Class 11, Class 12, ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, or Doctoral) in an institution recognized by Government / UGC / AICTE. Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (₹2.5 Lakh) per annum. The student must not be receiving any other government scholarship for the same study.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: SC/ST/OBC Students pursuing Class 11 and above

required_documents: Aadhaar Card (linked with mobile number for OTP authentication)
Caste / Community Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (Tahsildar/SDM)
Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (family income ≤ ₹2.50 Lakh)
Previous Examination Marksheet / Qualifying Educational Certificate
Bonafide Student Certificate / Current Course Fee Receipt / Admission Letter
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar seeded bank account)
Domicile / Residential Certificate
application_mode: Online via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or UMANG App
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) to generate a One-Time Registration (OTR) number
Log in to the student dashboard and fill personal, academic, and bank account details
Upload caste certificate, income certificate, and institutional bonafide proof
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarship' under your state and category department and submit application
School/college Institute Nodal Officer (INO) and State Nodal Officer (SNO) verify credentials, after which funds are disbursed via DBT PFMS
